scripts.//dev:zero-cache: zero-cache reads its own env, so .env is sourced here rather than by our code. ZERO_UPSTREAM_DB defaults to DATABASE_URL: it is the same database, and writing the password twice is how the two drift apart. `:=` inside `set -a` exports the assignment, which is why it sits before `set +a`.
scripts.dev:zero-cache: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; : "${ZERO_UPSTREAM_DB:=$DATABASE_URL}"; set +a; cd apps/server && exec pnpm exec zero-cache-dev'
scripts.//dev:mobile: Metro, on purpose and on its own. Not part of `pnpm dev`: apps/mobile deliberately names its script `start` so turbo's dev fan-out skips it, because a bundler only a device can talk to has no business booting with the API and Vite.
